Dear Doctor ,

Re : Ms Sally Mc Conville                                                                                      Commented [jc1]: McConville

I am writing to refer Ms. Mc Conville , a 38- year-old single administrator who has been suffering from
respiratory distress due to possible acute asthma or pneumonia .

Ms. Mc Conville is a non smoker and has no known allergies . She has a past history of asthma ,                Commented [jc2]: non-smoker
hypertension and depression . Her current medication includes ; ramipril , paroxetime , fluticasone and        Commented [jc3]: paroxetine
Ventoline puffs.

Initially , Ms. Mc Conville presented to me on 10 / 09 / 14 with the complaints of runny nose , chest
wheeze and productive cough of yellow phlegm over the previous two days . Her general examination
revealed a low grade fever , a congested throat and nasal congestion . In addition , the chest auscultation
showed widespread wheeze . Two days later , the patient showed deterioration with increasing the               Commented [jc4]: of the
shortness of breath and the chest wheeze . Moreover , her work of breathing was mildly increased . She
was diagnosed with an acute exacerbation of asthma for which amoxicillin and prednisolon were                  Commented [jc5]: prednisolone
commenced .

On today`s consultation , Ms. Mc Conville felt unwell . On examination , it was found that shortness of
breath occurred at rest along with an obvious accessory muscle use. Regrettably, Her vital signs worsened      Commented [jc6]: had
in the form of increasing respiratory rate and pulse rate . Despite Ventoline nebulization , her respiratory
distress did not improve after 15 minutes.

I would greatly appreciate your urgent attention regarding Ms. Mc Conville`s condition for further
assessment and management.

Yours sincerely

Dr X

Ms. Mc Conville is a non smoker and has no known allergies . She has a past history of asthma ,

distress did not improve after 15 minutes.

I would greatly appreciate your urgent attention regarding Ms. Mc Conville`s condition for further
assessment and management.

Yours sincerely

Dr X
